dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-02.spokenScript: Hello, Patrick! Sawatdee. You are awake. Do not panic. You fell through the Bangkok rift and landed in the lobby of the Chao Phraya Star Hotel.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-02.outputTranscript: Hello, Patrick! Sawatdee. You are awake. Do not panic. You fell through the Bangkok rift and landed in the lobby of the Chao Phraya Star Hotel.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-03.spokenScript: ไม่เป็นไร. Before you step outside, you need your first kind of magic: polite Thai. We will start with: สวัสดีครับ. Hello.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-03.outputTranscript: ไม่เป็นไร. Before you step outside, you need your first kind of magic: polite Thai. We will start with: สวัสดีครับ. Hello.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-04.spokenScript: วันนี้, I will teach you ten Thai basics you can use right now: hello, your name, nice to meet you, thank you, sorry, yes, no, price, bathroom, and I am thirsty.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-04.outputTranscript: วันนี้, I will teach you ten Thai basics you can use right now: hello, your name, nice to meet you, thank you, sorry, yes, no, price, bathroom, and I am thirsty.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-06.spokenScript: Before you step outside, you need your first kind of magic: polite Thai. Hold Speak and talk, release to let the AI judge, tap Hear for my example, Review to retry, and Skip only if your mouth has dramatically resigned.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-06.outputTranscript: Before you step outside, you need your first kind of magic: polite Thai. Hold Speak and talk, release to let the AI judge, tap Hear for my example, Review to retry, and Skip only if your mouth has dramatically resigned.

stage-01-hello-su.spokenScript: สวัสดี, Patrick. Look at me first. Start with a polite hello.
stage-01-hello-su.outputTranscript: สวัสดี, Patrick. Look at me first. Start with a polite hello.

stage-01-hello-coach.spokenScript: Say it slowly: sawatdee... khrap. สวัสดี means hello. ครับ makes it polite.
stage-01-hello-coach.outputTranscript: Say it slowly: sawatdee... khrap. สวัสดี means hello. ครับ makes it polite.

stage-01-my-name-is-patrick-su.spokenScript: ดีมาก. Now tell me who you are before the lobby asks questions.
stage-01-my-name-is-patrick-su.outputTranscript: ดีมาก. Now tell me who you are before the lobby asks questions.

stage-01-my-name-is-patrick-coach.spokenScript: Break it down: ผม, ชื่อ, Patrick, and ครับ. Repeat: phom chue Patrick khrap.
stage-01-my-name-is-patrick-coach.outputTranscript: Break it down: ผม, ชื่อ, Patrick, and ครับ. Repeat: phom chue Patrick khrap.

stage-01-nice-to-meet-you-su.spokenScript: I am Su. ยินดี, Patrick. When someone gives you their name, respond warmly.
stage-01-nice-to-meet-you-su.outputTranscript: I am Su. ยินดี, Patrick. When someone gives you their name, respond warmly.

stage-01-nice-to-meet-you-coach.spokenScript: ยินดี starts the phrase. รู้จัก is the connection. Repeat: yin dee tee dai roo jak khrap.
stage-01-nice-to-meet-you-coach.outputTranscript: ยินดี starts the phrase. รู้จัก is the connection. Repeat: yin dee tee dai roo jak khrap.

stage-01-thank-you-su.spokenScript: I am helping you through this. ขอบคุณ is what you need here.
stage-01-thank-you-su.outputTranscript: I am helping you through this. ขอบคุณ is what you need here.

stage-01-thank-you-coach.spokenScript: ขอบคุณ means thank you. Add ครับ to sound respectful. Repeat: khop khun khrap.
stage-01-thank-you-coach.outputTranscript: ขอบคุณ means thank you. Add ครับ to sound respectful. Repeat: khop khun khrap.

stage-01-sorry-su.spokenScript: Oops. You bumped the suitcase. ขอโทษ, say sorry before it gets awkward.
stage-01-sorry-su.outputTranscript: Oops. You bumped the suitcase. ขอโทษ, say sorry before it gets awkward.

stage-01-sorry-coach.spokenScript: ขอโทษ repairs the moment. ครับ makes it polite. Repeat: kho thot khrap.
stage-01-sorry-coach.outputTranscript: ขอโทษ repairs the moment. ครับ makes it polite. Repeat: kho thot khrap.

stage-01-yes-su.spokenScript: พร้อมไหม, are you ready to keep practicing?
stage-01-yes-su.outputTranscript: พร้อมไหม, are you ready to keep practicing?

stage-01-yes-coach.spokenScript: ใช่ answers yes. Add ครับ. Repeat: chai khrap.
stage-01-yes-coach.outputTranscript: ใช่ answers yes. Add ครับ. Repeat: chai khrap.

stage-01-no-su.spokenScript: If something is wrong, say ไม่ใช่. Do not freeze.
stage-01-no-su.outputTranscript: If something is wrong, say ไม่ใช่. Do not freeze.

stage-01-no-coach.spokenScript: ไม่ changes the meaning. ใช่ becomes ไม่ใช่. Repeat: mai chai khrap.
stage-01-no-coach.outputTranscript: ไม่ changes the meaning. ใช่ becomes ไม่ใช่. Repeat: mai chai khrap.

stage-01-how-much-su.spokenScript: Before you buy water or a charm, ask ราคา.
stage-01-how-much-su.outputTranscript: Before you buy water or a charm, ask ราคา.

stage-01-how-much-coach.spokenScript: ราคา sets the topic. เท่าไหร่ asks the amount. Repeat: raa khaa tao rai khrap.
stage-01-how-much-coach.outputTranscript: ราคา sets the topic. เท่าไหร่ asks the amount. Repeat: raa khaa tao rai khrap.

stage-01-bathroom-where-su.spokenScript: The lobby is huge. Ask for ห้องน้ำ.
stage-01-bathroom-where-su.outputTranscript: The lobby is huge. Ask for ห้องน้ำ.

stage-01-bathroom-where-coach.spokenScript: ห้องน้ำ is what you need. อยู่ที่ไหน asks the location. Repeat: hong nam yoo tee nai khrap.
stage-01-bathroom-where-coach.outputTranscript: ห้องน้ำ is what you need. อยู่ที่ไหน asks the location. Repeat: hong nam yoo tee nai khrap.

stage-01-i-am-thirsty-su.spokenScript: Your Courage is dipping. Tell me, หิวน้ำ, you are thirsty.
stage-01-i-am-thirsty-su.outputTranscript: Your Courage is dipping. Tell me, หิวน้ำ, you are thirsty.

stage-01-i-am-thirsty-coach.spokenScript: ผม starts it. หิวน้ำ says what you need. Repeat: phom hiw naam khrap.
stage-01-i-am-thirsty-coach.outputTranscript: ผม starts it. หิวน้ำ says what you need. Repeat: phom hiw naam khrap.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-05.spokenScript: I am across the room. Click the glowing floor path or press Go To Su, and Patrick will walk to me.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-05.outputTranscript: I am across the room. Click the glowing floor path or press Go To Su, and Patrick will walk to me.
